scope: Read-only authorized own sent, personal received and current operational group incoming requests/history.
runtime: Power Automate and existing SharePoint connector only; Python is optional local tooling.

input.number: Existing PowerAppV2 number ParticipantId reference (title NumParticipantIdber preserved exactly); strict positive integer, must equal server-resolved unique own participant. Never actor authority.

outputs.requestsjson: JSON string of complete authorized minimal rows, or [] on any failure.
outputs.errormessage: Empty on OK; sanitized fixed error message otherwise.

publicRow.completed: Stored OperationComplete, never inferred from Accepted

actions.decline: Pending personal recipient or current operational active group member; own sender cannot respond.
actions.accept: Same responder plus current profile/group availability; hints only, action flow rechecks compatibility, full validity, capacity and shared guard.

publicRow.created: Original request Created timestamp string, preserved for existing history labels.

projection: Audience query runs before public projection. Every original Request_rows public field is retained, including created from Created, references/status/direction. No names are needed; no profile/account/email/raw request/technical operation fields are public.
caller: Preserved Invoker Raw auth -> _api/web/currentuser Id -> required unique indexed Participantaccount lookup -> own positive integer reference equality. No supplied actor or owner fallback.

connections.authentication: Exact original Raw token expression preserved; never Embedded.
connections.import: Create as new; select existing SharePoint connection. Envelope placeholder connectionName is intentional. No grants, permissions or new connector/licence.

runtimeMetadataGate.listIdentity: Expected list GUID and BaseTemplate 100 each run.
runtimeMetadataGate.fields: Complete bounded fields response; exact InternalName/type, required/unique flags and Hidden=false/ReadOnlyField=false on Requests; require Indexed=true for unique key fields, permit extra benign indexes on other request fields. SchemaXml XPath exact Lookup List target and exact Choice set/cardinality. Mismatch/missing/renamed/malformed = REQUEST_SCHEMA_UNVERIFIED; no guessed writes or automatic schema changes. SenderParticipantId and RecipientParticipantId are existing Number fields, not Lookup; exact SchemaXml /Field/@Decimals must equal 0. Existing names/column IDs are retained, with no duplicate columns or conversion.
runtimeMetadataGate.requestMappingStatus: OBSERVED_NUMBER_REFERENCES; target setup NOT APPLIED/VERIFIED. Current report correctly fails: six fields missing and RecipientParticipantId still required.

readPolicy.order: Original request Created desc, ID desc through native $orderby; no cursor or paging inputs.
readPolicy.complete: Request bound+1; reject null collection, __next and either odata nextLink spelling or count overflow. All collections complete before projection. Metadata bound 500, own account lookup bound 1 with top 2.
readPolicy.wholeListGate: Conservative full bounded list reads; any malformed/legacy incomplete request or invalid data can block the whole response. No silent skip, partial success, truncation, migration, deletions or schema writes.
readPolicy.errors: Clear all partial public rows; never return raw connector text, account identities or backend errors. Generic 502 is a read failure; reader has no writes/duplicate recovery path.

requestInvariants.send: SendOperationKey nonblank and unique; stored key is technical data, never caller authority. Reader neither generates nor mutates operation keys. Writer owns immutable typed intent/actor binding and replay checks under #47.
requestInvariants.connection: Pending or Accepted-incomplete uses exact open:person:minId:maxId or open:group:groupId:participant:senderId; terminal complete uses history:request:id. All ConnectionKeys unique.
requestInvariants.terminal: Nonblank WinningOperationKey. Accepted may remain incomplete/live/processing; Declined and Cancelled must be complete/history. Accepted complete must be history.
requestInvariants.legacy: Historical rows remain unchanged; incomplete or malformed legacy data returns REQUEST_DATA_INCOMPLETE until separate accepted mapping/migration exists.

membershipAuthority: Only Active own episode with empty LeftAt, exactly one active own row per group, exact request:id:participant:actor episode, Accepted+OperationComplete request bound to actor and group, complete personal source, SetupComplete true, group not Ended. Personal episode must equal group SourceRequestId with actor among its parties; group episode must target exact group with actor as sender. Left/provisional/missing/mismatched episodes grant no authority. No leader.
availability: Paused/inactive/not-open/invalid participant or Closed/Ended/full/busy/incomplete group yields UnavailablePending with no auto-cancel. Physical Active membership rows including provisional/paused count toward capacity. No freeing slots, membership/group/notification writes. Advisory accept is never proof of compatibility or a reserved slot.
integration: Parent integrates this isolated commit after review; no shared helper changes needed.
Use parent metadata-only RequestSchemaPreflight once for this batch; compare actual report before dependent smoke. Report mismatch as blocked mapping; do not silently repair.

Action buttons call #63/#11/#65 with their own stable intent contracts and refresh this reader after outcome.
Owner import/smoke is still required. #39 audience/ordinary participant access/privacy remain postponed.
Full UI binding under #67 remains explicitly PENDING; preserved shape/order do not prove existing screen, labels, output refresh or action binding works.
Parent updates the existing inline issue handover with v4 and observed Number-column mapping; no new draft handover file or PR.
nativeStatus: NOT_IMPORTED_NOT_TESTED; neither native runtime nor privacy certified.
referenceAdapter: Read SenderParticipantId/RecipientParticipantId as positive number / nullable positive number. Explicit equals(x,int(x)) for sender and equals(coalesce(recipient,0),int(coalesce(recipient,0))) gate rejects fractions; normalize both to int BEFORE canonical connection-key validation, authority comparisons and public projection. Null group recipient retained. System Id/TargetGroupId remain integer. Decimals=0 alone is not integer authority.
ownerSetupPrerequisites: Owner adds six missing fields using the accepted target mapping; OperationComplete optional Boolean defaults No.

Owner makes existing RecipientParticipantId optional; preserve existing SenderParticipantId/RecipientParticipantId names, Number type, Decimals=0 and column IDs. Do not create SenderParticipant/RecipientParticipant lookup duplicates.
Fresh corrected preflight must verify the complete target before dependent import/smoke. No tenant settings are changed by this reader or patch.
